_comment: Premodel leads Slack app. Create at https://api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From an app manifest. After creating: (1) replace the interactivity request_url host with your real deploy URL, (2) Install to Workspace, (3) copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-) and Signing Secret into Vercel env vars, (4) invite the bot to the leads channel with /invite @Premodel Leads.

display_information.name: Premodel Leads
display_information.description: Posts new Reveal requests and pushes them to the Notion CRM on a button click.
